$comment: IA for the thecodeflow.co clone. Section order and content taken from the saved original page (Join*.html), CLONE_SPEC.md §2 (Playwright-measured 2026-10-23) and the clone's src/App.jsx. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.source: https://www.thecodeflow.co/ (single-page Webflow waitlist site for a JavaScript course), cloned in this project
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; sections cross-checked against src/App.jsx render order

categories.SHELL: Page chrome and layers that sit outside the content flow: fixed nav, footer, and the fixed full-screen WebGL backdrop.
categories.HERO: The page-opening headline block with the primary call to action.
categories.CONTENT: Course substance: what the course teaches.
categories.FEATURES: Course format and benefit explanations, written as labelled text blocks.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is getting the visitor onto the waitlist: pitch, price/timeline, and the signup form.

shell.nav.description: Fixed top bar, transparent on desktop: a bold-keyword course blurb on the left, a scrambling '(ver 0.2)' version tag in the centre, and a small pill 'Join Waitlist' button plus the stacked 'THE CODE FLOW. CO' logo on the right. A Discord icon link exists in the markup but is always hidden. At 767px and below it gets a solid background, hides the blurb and version tag, and puts the logo left and the button right.
shell.nav.scope: Present on the single route /, fixed over every other section.

hero.course-intro.description: Full-viewport intro: a mono 'A 8+ HOURS VIDEO COURSE' label, a three-line giant condensed headline 'WEBFLOW BUILDS / WITH NO WEBFLOW / LIMITS' revealed word by word (the word LIMITS sits behind the cube), a two-line mono subline (JAVASCRIPT COURSE FOR / WEBFLOW DEVELOPERS), the 'Reserve your Spot' pill button, and a small '*LOCK PRICE AT 200$' note.
hero.course-intro.scope: Opens the single route / as its first content section (#intro).

content.curriculum-list.description: 'COURSE CONTENT' mono heading over a centred list of 20 very large condensed topic headings (API AND DATA through PERFORMANCE). At 991px and up every even item is shifted right by 10% and every item carries a small mono 001–020 counter, left of odd items and right of even ones; three items render behind the cube. Closes with a mono summary line about 8+ hours of video material.
content.curriculum-list.scope: Present once on the single route / (#content).

features.course-blocks.description: Two rows of two labelled text blocks (CONTENT, SKILLS, FEATURES (1/2), FEATURES (2/2)). Each block is a scrambling mono label, a two-line condensed heading, a short paragraph with an underlined phrase, and on some blocks a mono bullet list. Rows stack to one column at 991px and below.
features.course-blocks.scope: Present once on the single route /, as the first of the two #cta sections.

conversion.pitch-cta.description: Mid-page restatement of the offer: a mono 'SOLVE WEBFLOW WITH CODE' label, a two-line giant headline 'FIND THE / MISSING PIECE' (THE renders behind the cube), a second 'Reserve your Spot' button and the price note at normal mono size.
conversion.pitch-cta.scope: Opens the second #cta section on the single route /.

conversion.timeline-price-blocks.description: One row of two labelled text blocks with the same anatomy as features.course-blocks, but carrying launch and price facts: TIMELINE 'LIVE SEPT / 2025' with launch bullets, and PRICE 'LOCK PRICE / AT 200$*' with the price-increase caveat.
conversion.timeline-price-blocks.scope: Present once on the single route /, inside the second #cta section.

conversion.price-timeline-table.description: Full-width table of price over time: a header row of three phases (WAITLIST AND EARLY ACCESS, FIRST MODULE LAUNCH, FULL COURSE LIVE) with dates, then rows '200$' and '300+ $' each marked by a dot under its phase. Rows are separated by 1px lines that grow from the right on scroll. Hidden at 767px and below.
conversion.price-timeline-table.scope: Closes the second #cta section on the single route /, desktop and tablet only.

conversion.waitlist-signup.description: Two columns: left has a 'JOIN THE / WAITLIST' heading, a paragraph and a mono list of 3 perks; right has a First Name + Email form with underlines that grow on scroll and a 'Get In' submit button that stays dimmed (opacity .3) until the name is filled. On success the form is replaced by a scrambling 'YOU ARE IN. Catch up soon!' and the cube solves itself.
conversion.waitlist-signup.scope: Present once on the single route / (#signup).

shell.footer.description: Footer built around giant condensed letters 'THE / CODE / FLOW CO' that drop in from above character by character, with a 'TWEET @ ME' link, a WEBSITE anchor list (INTRO, CONTENT, CTA, SIGN UP) whose links dim to 50% on hover, the small logo, a privacy-policy link and the copyright and credit line. CODE and FLOW render behind the cube; the anchor list and logo are hidden at 991px and below.

shell.webgl-cube.description: Fixed full-screen transparent WebGL canvas behind all content (z-index -10) showing a dark glossy Rubik's cube. It drops in on load, tumbles and twists a layer every 1.68s, reacts to mouse movement, scroll position and clicks, darkens while a CTA button is hovered, and on '!' or a successful signup shows coloured stickers and flashes the page background. Words marked .z deliberately render behind it.
shell.webgl-cube.scope: Present behind every section of the single route /, last in DOM order.
